detailed_description: CSV to Excel converter transforms CSV (Comma-Separated Values) files into Excel spreadsheet format (.xlsx). Preview your data in a table before downloading. Perfect for opening CSV data in Excel.
usage_steps: Open the CSV to Excel tool page
Drag and drop a CSV file or click to select
Preview the data in table format
usage_examples: Convert CSV exports to Excel for editing
Open CSV data in Excel with proper formatting
Transform data files for spreadsheet analysis
